title: A1 Core checkpoint
subtitle: Read a compact passage with forms, phrases, and flow in view.
overview: You can now parse the main article patterns, common noun cases, present/imperfect/future/aorist signals, core dependent forms, and high-frequency theological vocabulary.
Before A2 Bridge, read this text aloud, mark every form you recognize, and leave unfamiliar forms honestly labelled for later study.

items.grc: ὁ λόγος τοῦ θεοῦ μένει ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ τῶν πιστευόντων.
items.en: The word of God remains in the heart of those who believe.

items.grc: ἔλαβον τὴν χάριν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπίστευσαν τῷ κυρίῳ.
items.en: They received his grace and believed the Lord.
He speaks to them so that they may have life.
